model.description: Which model reads a receipt. The Worker allowlists this and falls back to gpt-5-nano on anything it does not recognise, so a typo degrades rather than taking scanning down.

reasoning_effort.description: How much reasoning to buy before the answer: omit, none, minimal, low, medium, high. 'omit' leaves the setting out of the request entirely, for a tier that will not take one.

image_long_edge.description: The long edge a receipt is stored and sent at, in pixels. Above roughly 1440 the model downscales anyway, so the upload is wasted. Anything outside 256-4096 is treated as a typo and the app keeps its own value.

daily_cap.description: Scans a day, counted by the Worker. Lowers what the deployment allows and never raises it, so the ceiling in wrangler.jsonc still holds.
